import re,sys
sys.path[:0]=['/work/engine','/work/engine/src','/work/engine/lifecycle']
import emit_rules as emitter
original=emitter.emit_squid
LITERAL='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.3k (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/137.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'

def a6_emit_squid(rule, caps, rid):
    if 'HttpReqHdrUserAgentConditionCapability' not in caps:
        return original(rule,caps,rid)
    if caps != {'RejectActionCapability':'',
                'HttpReqHdrUserAgentConditionCapability':LITERAL}:
        raise ValueError('A6 only supports a single User-Agent prohibition')
    value = caps['HttpReqHdrUserAgentConditionCapability']
    if value.count(',')!=1 or '\n' in value or '\\r' in value:
        raise ValueError('A6 User-Agent literal failed integrity check')
    regex = '[[:blank:]]'.join(re.escape(chunk) for chunk in value.split(' '))
    if any(ch.isspace() for ch in regex):
        raise ValueError('Whitespace leaked into Squid ACL expression')
    acl=f're_blk_{emitter._h(rid)}'
    return (f'# >>> rid={rid}\n'
            f'acl {acl} req_header User-Agent {regex}\n'
            f'http_access deny {acl}\n'
            f'# <<< rid={rid}')
emitter.EMIT['squid']=a6_emit_squid
emitter.main('/work/engine/intermediate_outputs/a6_rules.json','/work/shared')
